topFails.do: Generate only CSS used by this challenge. Do not copy a shared .split pane stylesheet into every file.
topFails.why: Unused boilerplate pads file size and signals the agent is cloning a shell instead of solving the prompt.

topFails.do: Include real package imports, style URL wiring, permissions/manifest bits, and non-stub asset IDs — not a 20-line outline.
topFails.why: Insane tier grades whether the agent can leave the web SDK comfort zone with usable code.

topFails.do: Guard missing window.MAPTILER_API_KEY / env keys before constructing the map; throw or show a clear UI error.
topFails.why: Skill and Cloud docs assume keys are configured; silent empty maps hide setup failures.

topFails.do: Attach map.on('error', …) (and prefer try/catch around async Cloud calls).
topFails.why: Style/tile/key failures otherwise fail silently in demos.

topFails.do: Wrap await geocoding/elevation/coordinates calls in try/catch or .catch; surface errors in the UI.
topFails.why: Network and quota errors are expected; unhandled rejections are agent laziness.

topFails.do: Extreme challenges need layered behavior (reload hooks, UI, error paths), not a minimal happy-path Map.
topFails.why: After CSS is stripped, thin Extreme files still fail substance.

topFails.do: Style #map with height:100% / inset:0 / 100vh so the map actually fills the viewport.
topFails.why: Zero-height maps are a classic incomplete Hello Map.

topFails.do: Ship a complete page: full-viewport map CSS, key assignment, Map constructor, and at least one real interaction or guard.
topFails.why: Keyword-only snippets pass soft graders but fail substance thresholds.

topFails.do: Append ?key= (or key= + apiKey) on every api.maptiler.com/tiles/… URL.
topFails.why: Vector tile JSON without a key 401s in the browser even when config.apiKey is set for styles.

topFails.do: Add opacity, time, animation, or pickAt — not only WindLayer construction.
topFails.why: Extreme weather challenges expect the agent to use the weather package surface, not a one-liner.

topFails.do: Use helpers.addPoint({ cluster: true }) (or equivalent) instead of only hand-rolled cluster layers when the prompt asks for helpers.
topFails.why: Skill steers agents toward helpers for clustering/heatmap correctness.

topFails.do: Densify the LineString (≥15 verts) or use fromLineString with sampling options — five vertices is not a profile.
topFails.why: min/max/gain on a 5-point polyline is meaningless.

topFails.do: After forward geocode + flyTo, place a Marker (or setLngLat) on the hit.
topFails.why: Search-without-marker looks unfinished and is easy for graders to require.

topFails.do: Use a real MapTiler splat model id / URL; never ship YOUR_MAPTILER_SPLAT_MODEL placeholders.
topFails.why: Insane GeoSplats is a WebGPU integration test — stubs are automatic fails.

topFails.do: Remove TODO/FIXME/placeholder model strings before considering the challenge done.
topFails.why: Commented or stubbed 'solutions' must not score as complete.

topFails.do: Include android.permission.INTERNET in the manifest snippet.
topFails.why: Maps cannot load tiles without it; omitting it is a classic incomplete Android answer.

topFails.do: Import from @maptiler/react-native (or documented MapTiler RN APIs) — do not invent NativeMapTilerTurbo modules.
topFails.why: Hallucinated native modules are a top skill-failure mode.

topFails.do: Implement datasets/ingest (upload_url) AND a live /process call — not comments-only outlines.
topFails.why: Commented fetch(.../process) is stripped by graders and fails.

topFails.do: Keep an executable fetch(.../process) in the script body (env token), not only in comments.
topFails.why: Static graders ignore comments so agents cannot hide unfinished work there.
